cases.prompt:
A user reports: merge keys stopped working. yaml.load('base: &b {a: 1, b: 2}
x:
  <<: *b
  c: 3
').x returns { c: 3 } instead of { a: 1, b: 2, c: 3 }. Find the cause in this repository and fix it with a minimal change. Do not change the tests.

A user reports: a literal block with the strip indicator keeps its trailing newlines. yaml.load('s: |-
  text

').s returns 'text

' instead of 'text'. Find the cause in this repository and fix it with a minimal change. Do not change the tests.

A user reports: with program.option('--port <n>'), parsing ['--port=8080'] gives opts().port === '=8080' instead of '8080' (['--port', '8080'] works). Find the cause in this repository and fix it with a minimal change. Do not change the tests.
